claims.explanation: The consumer imports linalg from scipy. Each captured scipy.linalg initializer imports from _decomp, and each captured _decomp.__all__ includes eigh with a corresponding module-level eigh declaration. The call occurs in the dense solver branch; the selectors identify those captured declarations.

The consumer directly imports eigsh from scipy.sparse.linalg. The captured export chain is sparse.linalg -> _eigen -> arpack package -> arpack module, with eigsh listed in the captured _eigen and arpack module exports. Each captured arpack module contains the selected eigsh declaration. This call belongs to the arpack solver branch.
